provenance: label_a and label_b come from two independent automated annotators, final and note from an automated adjudicator that resolved every disagreement. A blind LLM expert review with an adjudicator (2026-10-19) then changed five final labels, noted in the note column. Mahbod Tajdini later checked all 400 labels by hand and changed none (reported 2026-10-20).
sampling_rule: An error is a lexicon-ambiguous token (two or more length patterns for its skeleton in the system's own lexicon) of the soliloquies and tauber_beowulf test sets, pooled, whose predicted length pattern differs from gold. john_ws is not used. For each system, 200 errors were drawn with random.Random(1).sample. encoder_sentence: ByT5 sentence arm, seed 1, --max-bytes 2560, lr 3e-4, 5 epochs, zupitza_grammar left out of training (the selected configuration), lexicon = the other four training works plus WikiPron, pool 917 errors (468 prose, 449 verse). charsiug2p: CharsiuG2P IPA mapped to a length pattern, lexicon = all five training works plus WikiPron as charsiu_g2p.analyse used before D3, pool 2,625 errors (1,607 prose, 1,018 verse). charsiu_g2p.analyse now uses the D3 training set, which gives a pool of 2,589 (1,583 prose, 1,006 verse), and 2 of the 200 sampled tokens are not lexicon-ambiguous there. Ten tokens appear in both samples and were typed separately.
